### Quality checklist

- [ ] Repo is publicly accessible
- [ ] README explains what the pack does
- [ ] License is OSS (SPDX identifier matches the `license` field)
- [ ] At least one skill loads via `./install-skill-pack <author>/<name>` in Aeon
- [ ] Manifest passes `pnpm validate` locally
- [ ] `install_command` matches `./install-skill-pack <repo>` exactly
